description: USE THIS for "nearest toilet", "bathroom near", "where can I fill water, dump, shower, fuel up, buy groceries, do laundry, get propane or air, find a mechanic, pharmacy, urgent care, hardware store, post office, outfitter or coffee shop", or "electric charger near" at a latitude and longitude anywhere in the United States. kind is toilets (the default: 21,390 recorded toilets with the agency that lists them), chargers (the Department of Energy station list), or one mapped resupply kind: potable_water, shower, dump_station, fuel, grocery, laundry, propane, air, mechanic, pharmacy, urgent_care, hardware, mail, outfitter, coffee (cafes within 25 miles of a camp record only). Returns up to 25 records within a straight-line radius (up to 50 miles), nearest first, with the source and its date. A recorded toilet can be closed for the season, and the mapped points are a floor from OpenStreetMap, not a survey: hours, brands and whether a place still exists go stale, so say "OpenStreetMap lists", never "there is". It never says a place is open.

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (negative in the US).
